# Subway Seat for Starship

Palettes use the slot names of Starship's Gruvbox Rainbow preset, so its segments turn into a red → orange → gold → avocado stripe. `subway-seat.toml` is a complete prompt built on it.

[Starship](https://starship.rs) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/starship/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`palettes/subway-seat.toml`](palettes/subway-seat.toml) | append to ~/.config/starship.toml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`palettes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](palettes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | append to ~/.config/starship.toml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`palettes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`](palettes/subway-seat-enamel.toml) | append to ~/.config/starship.toml |
| All three | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | ~/.config/starship.toml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/starship.toml:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat'
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/starship.toml:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat_tunnel'
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/starship.toml:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat_enamel'
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
